title: encelia canescens var. parvifolia
intro: Encelia canescens var. parvifolia, commonly known as Brittlebrush, is a shrubby perennial plant native to the southwestern United States and Mexico, belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Encelia canescens var. parvifolia include its ability to exhibit antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer properties, suggesting its potential in preventing chronic diseases. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions are primarily sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which have been identified as key compounds in the plant's medicinal properties.
